result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a loading indicator remains over a restaurant image that otherwise appears loaded.

issues.description: A large circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, obscuring the food photo and making the card look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loader as soon as the image/content is ready, and ensure loading-state overlays do not remain visible on successfully rendered cards.
